description: Distribution (min/p10/q1/median/q3/p90/max, std dev, histogram, nearest hospital per percentile) of one figure per hospital for a code, never blending billing classes. The filter must name every term the group_by grouping keeps (all three of billing_class, methodology and setting for the default; the billing class or the methodology for those groupings; nothing for GROUP_BY_ALL), else INVALID_ARGUMENT; use *_UNSPECIFIED for 'not filed'. Counterpart to get_code_price_distribution. Backed by the hospital-prices serving snapshot; fails with UNAVAILABLE until the server has opened one.

code_type.description: Code system the billing code belongs to, e.g. APR-DRG, CDM, CPT, HCPCS, MS-DRG, RC.

filter.description: Keeps only some of the grouped rows (see group_by). Each field left out matches any value; set a field (even to its *_UNSPECIFIED value, which means 'not filed') to require it. Billing classes are never blended: a facility fee and a professional fee are separate bills.

group_by.description: Which rows exist: one per billing class + methodology + setting (GROUP_BY_PER_COMBINATION, the default), per billing class, per methodology, or GROUP_BY_ALL (one figure over everything, blending billing classes), or GROUP_BY_FACILITY_PLUS_PROFESSIONAL (one row per methodology and setting the hospital files under both the facility and the professional billing class, the two added together, i.e. the combined bill; terms are methodology and setting, no billing class; no row where there is no professional counterpart). Applied before filter, which may name only the terms the grouping still keeps (e.g. GROUP_BY_BILLING_CLASS with a methodology filter, or GROUP_BY_ALL with any filter, is rejected as INVALID_ARGUMENT).

min_sample_count.description: Only hospitals backed by at least this many billing records. Negative values are rejected.

reference_price.description: When positive, hospitals_below_reference counts hospitals priced strictly below it.

state.description: Optional two-letter USPS state code (e.g. "TX", case-insensitive): only hospitals with a location in that state are counted. A hospital in several states counts in each, so state figures can add up to more than national ones. Empty means every hospital; anything that is not a state code is rejected as INVALID_ARGUMENT.

statistic.description: Which per-hospital figure to distribute (default average).

name: get_code_provider_price_distribution
title: Get provider price distribution for a code
